message: Create the sales star: fact_sales and the customer, product, date and store dimensions

project.name: Sales Star
project.description: A small sales data mart: one fact table at the grain of an order line, with customer, product, date and store dimensions.

schema:dw.name: dw
schema:dw.description: The dimensional model: conformed dimensions and the sales fact.

table:dw.dim_customer.name: dim_customer
table:dw.dim_customer.description: A person or company that buys from us: one row per customer (type 1: changes overwrite).

column:dw.dim_customer.customer_key.name: customer_key
column:dw.dim_customer.customer_key.description: Surrogate key: meaningless, generated by the warehouse.

column:dw.dim_customer.customer_id.name: customer_id
column:dw.dim_customer.customer_id.description: Business key from the order system.

table:dw.dim_date.name: dim_date
table:dw.dim_date.description: The calendar: one row per day, so reports can group by week, month, quarter and year without date functions.

column:dw.dim_date.date_key.name: date_key
column:dw.dim_date.date_key.description: Surrogate key in the form YYYYMMDD.

table:dw.dim_product.name: dim_product
table:dw.dim_product.description: Something we sell: one row per product.

table:dw.dim_store.name: dim_store
table:dw.dim_store.description: Where a sale happened: one row per shop or web channel.

column:dw.dim_store.store_name.name: store_name
column:dw.dim_store.store_name.description: Name of the shop or channel.

table:dw.fact_sales.name: fact_sales
table:dw.fact_sales.description: Sales: one row per order line (the grain). Measures are additive.

column:dw.fact_sales.order_number.name: order_number
column:dw.fact_sales.order_number.description: Degenerate dimension: the order this line belongs to.

column:dw.fact_sales.unit_price.name: unit_price
column:dw.fact_sales.unit_price.description: Price of one unit at the time of sale.

column:dw.fact_sales.net_amount.name: net_amount
column:dw.fact_sales.net_amount.description: quantity x unit_price - discount_amount: the sales value.
